async def act(page):
    # Type 'Abishek' into the textbox to invite members and wait for suggestions
    await page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Select members to invite').fill('Abishek')
    # Wait for suggestions to appear and select the user 'Abishek'

    await page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Select members to invite').fill('Vinta')
    await page.get_by_role('option', name='Vinta').click()

    await page.get_by_role('combobox', name='Choose a role permission').select_option('Guest')

    await page.get_by_role('button', name='Add to project').click()
